tweets.text:
EXCLUSIVE 🚨 A 45-page criminal complaint has been filed with the FBI against these politicians and their campaign cohorts: 

**Bonus below**

- Susan Crawford for WI 
- Susan Crawford personally
- Crawford's Treasurer David J Mahoney
- Janet for Justice campaign 
- Janet Protasiewicz personally 
- Janet For Justice campaigns' Treasurer, Michael Steinle
- Jill Karofsky campaign 
- Jill Karofsky personally
- Karofsky's campaign Treasurer Mary McCarthy
- ActBlue
- Democratic Party of Wisconsin
- Ben Wikler Chairman of the Dem Party of WI 
- the Democratic National Committee (DNC)  
- Josh Kaul, WI state attorney general who cheated in 
      his elections
 - US Senator Tammy Baldwin 

For Smurfing, i.e. criminally laundering money into their campaigns.   

II. Federal Statutes Potentially Violated

1. 18 U.S.C. § 1956 – Money Laundering

2. 18 U.S.C. § 1957 – Monetary Transactions in Property Derived from Unlawful Activity

3. 18 U.S.C. § 1001 – False Statements to Federal Agencies

4. 52 U.S.C. § 30122 – Contributions in the Name of Another

5. 18 U.S.C. § 1343 – Wire Fraud

6. 18 U.S.C. § 1341 – Mail Fraud

7. 18 U.S.C. § 371 – Conspiracy to Defraud the United States

8. 18 U.S.C. § 1028 – Identity Theft

9. 18 U.S.C. § 1030 – Computer Fraud and Abuse Act

10. 15 U.S.C. § 6801–6809 – Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act

11. 31 U.S.C. 5311 et seq - Bank Secrecy Act  (12 CFR 21.11, 12 CFR 21.21)

12. 4. 52 U.S.C. § 30122 – Contributions in the Name of Another (FECA)

13. 18 U.S.C. § 1028 – Identity Fraud and Document Fraud

State ETHICS complaints were filed in the past against the campaigns of Josh Kaul, Susan Crawford, Janet Protasiewicz, the Democratic Party of WIS and the likes of City of Racine Mayor Cory Mason. Guess what? They are still in play!

A lawsuit was filed and pending on these complaints in Kenosha County State Circuit Court. For closed session records the ETHICS Commission (controlled by Speaker of the Assembly Robin Vos) refuses to hand over to the four Plaintiffs.  

The reckoning comes for all, in time. @elonmusk @POTUS @BryanSteil @RonJohnsonWI @KenPaxtonTX @JasonMiyaresVA @RodDMartin @AGPamBondi @FBIDirectorKash @Rasmussen_Poll @AsheinAmerica  @EmeraldRobinson @MayorCoryMason
